Welcome to the gear update!

For a few days there wont be a ton of use for a lot of the resources. Fear not I am building an economy system and you will be able to sell them.

If you had played before, I have migrated your stats to a special helmet slot item. You can choose to keep it or just roll over it for the inteneded experience.

There will be issues and the balance needs some work. I would love some feedback via discord is best but the steam workshop is fine too!

Click anywhere on this window to close it.
